sections.section: RULES - National Savings Deposit Accounts Rules 1974
sections.description:
NATIONAL SAVINGS DEPOSIT ACCOUNTS
NATIONAL SAVINGS
DEPOSIT ACCOUNTS
RULES, 1974
(Amendment of R.2)
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II,
13th August, 2011]
S.R.O.
764(I)/2011, dated 11-8-2011.---In exercise of the powers conferred by section
28 of the Public Debt Act, 1944 (XVIII of 1944), the Federal Government is
pleased to direct that the following further amendment shall be made in the
National Savings Deposit Accounts Rules,
1974, the same having been previously published vide Notification No. S.R.O.
590(I)/2011, dated the 8th June, 2011, as required under subsection (1) of the
said section, namely:--
In
the aforesaid Rules, in rule 2, in sub-rule (1), for clause (v), the following
shall be substituted, namely:--
"(v)
all institutional investment shall be discontinued with immediate
effect.".
